response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only brief, non-dedicated C++ exposure in early roles, and no evidence of leading cloud compute platforms or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and domains
Proven open-source contributions and technical mentoring through workshops
Experience with distributed systems and high-throughput services
concerns: No demonstrable 8+ years of C++ programming as required
Lacks direct experience with cloud compute platform architecture or leadership
Minimal evidence of managing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems at scale
